pages.title: Asking for an appointment
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Good afternoon. How can I help you?
lines.audioText: Good afternoon. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: My back hurts. I’d like to make an appointment
lines.audioText: My back hurts. I’d like to make an appointment.
lines.translation: Minhas costas doem. Gostaria de marcar uma consulta

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yesterday afternoon. Is there an appointment today?
lines.audioText: Yesterday afternoon. Is there an appointment today?
lines.translation: Ontem à tarde. Tem uma consulta hoje?

pages.title: Your appointment time
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hello, Ana. This is a message about your appointment at the Green Clinic. The time is now four o’clock this afternoon, not three. The address is the same. Please come to reception ten minutes before your appointment. You don’t need to reply if four is OK. If you need another time, please call reception. Thank you
pages.audioText: Hello, Ana. This is a message about your appointment at the Green Clinic. The time is now four o’clock this afternoon, not three. The address is the same. Please come to reception ten minutes before your appointment. You don’t need to reply if four is OK. If you need another time, please call reception. Thank you.
pages.greeting: I have an update for you!

items.prompt: What is the new appointment time?
items.answer: The appointment is now at four this afternoon

items.prompt: When should Ana arrive at reception?
items.answer: Ana should arrive ten minutes early, at three fifty

items.prompt: What should Ana do if she needs another time?
items.answer: Ana should call reception if she needs another time
